title: Palace sees nothing wrong with ‘Anak’ as Marcos intro song in APEC banquet
summary: The Palace sees nothing wrong with the use of Freddie Aguilar's classic hit "Anak" as the music accompaniment of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr's entrance to the APEC Gala Dinner.
